name: Lewis & Short Latin dictionary lookup in BaseX

mentions.name: Lewis & Short Latin dictionary lookup in BaseX
mentions.description: This tool performs fast Latin-to-English lookups against an XML-TEI formatted edition of the 19th century Lewis & Short dictionary stored in a high-performance XML database engine (BaseX), using a RESTXQ endpoint and XQuery code to dynamically reformat entries into Org mode for display in an Emacs pop-up buffer.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also want to demonstrate how I use a high-performance XML database engine to quickly perform Latin-to-English lookups against an XML-TEI formatted edition of the 19th century Lewis & Short dictionary, and using a RESTXQ endpoint and some XQuery code to dynamically reformat the entries into Org-mode for display in a pop-up buffer.
